headline: Putin, war leader and election campaign chief, prepares Russia for military escalation
description: For the first time since the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Russians will elect their MPs between September 18 and 20. Orchestrated by the Kremlin, this vote carries no real electoral stakes and serves above all as a tool to rally support for the war effort.

headline: Netanyahu orders evacuation of some West Bank settler outposts
description: In response to increased US pressure, Israeli's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered the evacuation of certain settlements in the occupied West Bank that were established without government approval.

headline: Down with sexual laziness! Why sex is worth putting in the effort
description: Amid a growing trend of 'dating fatigue' and an increasing aversion to making an effort sexually, Le Monde's sex columnist Maïa Mazaurette explains how taking the easy way out leads nowhere when it comes to pleasure.

headline: 'China will not replace the United States as a global power'
description: Dan Wang, a Chinese-Canadian researcher living in the US, has devoted his latest book, 'Breakneck: China's Quest to Engineer the Future,' to the two rival powers. In an interview with Le Monde, he discussed what sets them apart, but also what brings them together.

headline: Racism and hazing: After the suicide of 21-year-old Joris, a rural French town searches for answers
description: The family of 21-year-old Joris Laurencin is convinced that his suicide in mid-July was linked to the racist insults and repeated bullying he endured at the hands of one young man and his gang. The courts have opened an investigation against persons unknown for 'hazing, verbal abuse, repeated death threats based on race, psychological harassment and incitement to suicide.'

headline: Germany's Soviet past looms over high-stakes election in Saxony-Anhalt: 'I do not consider Russians to be enemies'
description: Ahead of elections on Sunday, in which the far-right Alternative for Germany could win in this region of the former East Germany, the city of Stendal – where 10,000 Red Army soldiers were stationed during the Cold War – exemplifies the unique relationship between the former German Democratic Republic and Russia.
